cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Hope Keeps Moving
cards.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The hall rejected our wedding booking. Apparently we're meant to marry somewhere less municipal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every venue is booked for June.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then September gives us three more months to practise being married.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My parents can't travel in September.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we go to them. Their garden! We're finally finding out where this wedding belongs.
